name: Lookahead decoding acceptance length and speedup on Vicuna-13B (temperature=0)
methodology: temperature=0, 6 tasks. Average acceptance length τ = 1.62 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 1.58x mean across tasks.
notes: Lookahead decoding uses Jacobi iteration for parallel decoding. No auxiliary models or data stores. Exact (distribution-preserving). Speedup ≈ acceptance length because draft is nearly free. Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding.
